history.origins: Ugly was invented in Australia in the 1980s by CARDS (Committee for the Advanced Research into Deck Statistics), a group of university students. It is loosely based on Hearts and Knaves and is played in Canberra, Perth, and elsewhere in Australia.
timeline: 1980s: Invented in Australia by CARDS (Committee for the Advanced Research into Deck Statistics), a group of university students.

setup.dealing: All cards dealt. Pass cards (escalating each round).

rules.objective: Accumulate the highest total score over multiple hands; win tricks for +1 point each while avoiding Jacks (negative points) and using the Ugly and Charm cards to modify scoring.
rules.gameplay: Dealer's left picks trump (or no trump). Pass cards (increases each round). Win tricks for +1 pt each. Avoid Jacks (negative). 7â™¦ (Ugly): doubles Jack penalties. 7â™¦ + no Jacks = double trick score. 7â™£ (Charm): cancels Ugly's doubling. Both Ugly+Charm + no Jacks = 4x trick score.
